licensePolicy.activation: device-bound signed token after manual payment verification and explicit admin approval

notes: Commercial approval was granted by the product owner after successful download, installation, and in-place update over the previous version on a physical Android device.
Application ID and database name remain unchanged to support in-place updates from the same signed lineage.
Commercial approval applies to version 2.6.17 and does not imply that every Android model has been tested.
Monthly and annual plans remain time-limited. They never convert to lifetime automatically.
Lifetime activation applies only to the purchased app version and does not include future version updates.
Payment must be verified manually and a manager must approve the order before a license is issued.
The private signing key remains only in protected server-side secrets and is never embedded in the APK or committed in plaintext.
Continue routine validation of trial expiry, post-trial data retention, activation states, offline operation, and backup/restore across supported devices.
commercialApprovalBasis: Owner confirmed successful download, installation, and update over the previous version on a physical Android device.
